title: Angle Stream Theta Payload (DEPRECATED)
description: DEPRECATED dual-emit copy of the inclination frame, carrying the console's theta = 90 - inclination. Emitted on the same tick, from the same sample, with the same ts, immediately AFTER the canonical inclination frame. It exists so a subscriber built against the old convention keeps working across the one release in which the two apps cross over. A subscriber that sees a native inclination frame within DUAL_EMIT_SUPPRESS_MS must DROP the theta copy: applying both doubles the apparent sample rate.
$comment: `link` is a verbatim copy of the one in frame-heartbeat.json; tests/py/test_schemas.py asserts they stay identical.

theta.description: CONSOLE_THETA_VERTICAL_DEG - inclination_deg. 90 = vertical, decreasing as the needle lies over. Explicit null means 'no angle', not zero.

state.description: needle-guide's SerialPortClient link state, verbatim. Free-form on the guide side: carry it, show it, never branch on it.

live.description: True only for `connected`, i.e. sensor samples are actually flowing.
